review_text: Bottle ekdum mast hai, paani 12 ghante thanda rehta hai. Paisa vasool!
Dhakkan se paani leak hota hai, bag poora geela ho gaya. Bahut bekaar.
Wah kya baat hai, 10 din mein delivery. Itni fast delivery toh kabhi nahi dekhi 🙄
Kapda accha hai aur colour bhi same hai jaisa photo mein tha, bas size thoda chhota hai.
कपड़ा ठीक है लेकिन सिलाई कमज़ोर है, एक धुलाई में धागा निकल गया।
बहुत सुंदर कुर्ता है, मेरी माँ को बहुत पसंद आया।
Oh great, the speaker died on day two. Exactly what I wanted for my party. Five stars for creativity.
Sound bahut loud hai, bass bhi accha. Battery 8 ghante chalti hai.
Customer care ko 3 baar call kiya, koi jawab nahi. Replacement kab milega?
Price thoda zyada hai but quality top class hai, recommend karunga.
Packet khula hua aaya, kurta pe daag tha. Return bhi nahi ho raha.
